projects.name: YTKACE
projects.localizedDescription: YouTube with the YTKACE tweak. Modern iOS variant only. Downloads are the unmodified IPA published by itzzace/ytkace. Tweak-only releases may need a manual installation even when the app version is unchanged; see this source's news and release notes.

projects.name: EeveeSpotify
projects.localizedDescription: Spotify with EeveeSpotifyReincarnated, prebuilt by estrogencat. Regular Liquid Glass IPA for signing with SideStore; excludes the patched variant. Downloads go directly to the original upstream release. Tweak-only releases may need a manual installation even when the app version is unchanged; see this source's news and release notes.
